name: describe_design
description: What is open: the garment, its pieces with their fabric and colour, the fabrics, the undo/redo labels, and the fabric kinds and colour swatches the other tools accept. Call first.

name: set_fabric_kind
description: Make a fabric hang like another kind of cloth (jersey, denim, poplin, fleece, wool suiting). The 3D garment re-drapes.

fabric.description: Fabric id or name (as describe_design lists them); leave out for the garment's main fabric

name: set_fabric_color
description: Recolour a fabric (every piece cut from it). Accepts #rrggbb or a swatch name like navy or heather grey.

fabric.description: Fabric id or name (as describe_design lists them); leave out for the garment's main fabric

name: tune_fabric
description: Change one physical value of a fabric, either to a value or by a factor (factor 2 = twice as stiff/stretchy-resistant/heavy). Fields: density, thickness, friction, stretchWarp, stretchWeft, stretchShear, bendingWarp, bendingWeft. Density is kg/m², bending is stiffness, stretch is resistance to stretching.

fabric.description: Fabric id or name (as describe_design lists them); leave out for the garment's main fabric

name: add_fabric
description: Add a new fabric of a kind and colour (for a contrast piece). Nothing uses it until use_fabric_for_piece or set_garment_fabric.

name.description: optional; default from colour and kind

name: use_fabric_for_piece
description: Cut a piece (every copy of it, e.g. both sleeves) from a fabric. Leave fabric out to go back to the garment's main fabric.

name: set_garment_fabric
description: Make a fabric the garment's main one (every piece without its own fabric).

name: undo
description: Undo the last edit (the person's or the assistant's), as the Undo button does.
